title: Alpha Pay — production mobile engineering
content: At Alpha Pay in Richmond, BC, Jacky works as a Software Developer focused on frontend and mobile systems. He has architected React Native applications with Redux Toolkit, integrated multi-region USD/CAD routing, and built CI/CD delivery pipelines with Expo EAS. This is the newest record of his employment and supersedes the older résumé PDF when answering who his current employer is.

title: Ulala Technologies — high-volume logistics UI
content: At Ulala Technologies in Delta, BC, Jacky built Vue 3 and TypeScript logistics interfaces. He improved the data architecture for views handling more than 100,000 records, implemented order, delivery, route, and role-based access workflows, and used AWS S3 presigned URLs for uploads. title: NYIT — AI campus assistant
content: At New York Institute of Technology in Vancouver, Jacky engineered an AI campus assistant using LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation, and Supabase vector search. The project was designed around registrar questions and reduced manual registrar inquiries by 30%. It demonstrates that he has built RAG for a real information domain rather than only a generic chat interface.

title: Cognizant — real-time 3D industrial interface
content: As a Frontend Developer at Cognizant in Shanghai from July 2022 to May 2023, Jacky developed an industrial 3D factory-management interface with React, TypeScript, Babylon.js, and Ant Design. He rendered equipment-position data from REST APIs into a factory model and integrated real-time IoT telemetry through WebSockets. A later résumé also describes more than 100 equipment nodes, Redux Toolkit, JWT authentication, and Webpack Module Federation.

title: Cognizant trainee — mobile product foundations
content: During his Cognizant trainee period from March to July 2022, Jacky worked on mobile commerce interfaces and API integration. Available records describe responsive UI, centralized state, delivery tracking and data visualization, plus Scrum planning and feature testing. The underlying résumé and older project notes differ on whether the client stack was React Native or Vue, so Trace should describe the product responsibilities confidently but avoid asserting one framework unless the distinction is directly requested.

title: MoodTrack — AI product engineering
content: MoodTrack is Jacky's full-stack AI-powered mood tracking platform built with React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini. Its product work includes streamed AI reports, Vercel AI SDK integration, and anonymous community features. It is useful evidence of connecting an AI feature to a broader product experience rather than treating the model response as the whole application.

title: RecruitPro — multi-module recruiting platform
content: RecruitPro is a recruiting platform project with résumé parsing, interview scheduling, candidate matching, role-based access, and analytics. Jacky implemented more than five coordinated modules and managed shared application state with Redux. The project is evidence of workflow design and cross-feature state management.

title: Medium-style publishing platform
content: Jacky built a MERN publishing platform from June to September 2024 with rich-text editing, CRUD workflows, comments, tags, image uploads, dark mode, and responsive typography. The site intentionally exposes reasoning and incomplete thinking instead of presenting only polished outcomes. This supports an inference that he values iteration, intellectual honesty, documentation, and reflective learning.

content: In August 2026, Jacky rebuilt the portfolio Splash around 'Still learning. Still building. Still debugging.' He kept the deliberate drag gesture, removed generic developer language, made motion deterministic, and improved keyboard and reduced-motion accessibility. The decision shows attention to interaction intent, accessibility, restraint, and maintaining a distinctive product voice.
